batch.title: Where a practice can go: cutoffs the paper may never have set
batch.notes: 47 findings on where a practice can be put (slope, rainfall, soil depth, distance to water and so on) that we stored as a hard cutoff. Often the paper only recommends a range, or ranks land, and never says land outside it is unsuitable. Approve = the cutoff is right as recorded. Hold = keep the finding but turn the cutoff into a preferred range (I make that change after your answers). Reject = set the finding aside (kept on record, not used). The AI's suggested call shows under the buttons; it is a suggestion only.
